name: Shanxi Taigang Stainless Steel Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanxi Taigang Stainless Steel Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sales of steel products in China and internationally. The company's products include stainless steel, cold-rolled silicon steel, carbon steel hot-rolled coils, railway wheel and axle steel, and alloy mold steel; ultra-pure ferritic, duplex steel, tank container, non-magnetic steel, and railway passenger and freight car steel; and high manganese, soft stainless steel precision foil hand-torn steel, pen tip steel, high-nitrogen stainless steel and other products.
